title: Text rendered as images for VLMs: LensVLM link post
description:
As an Anth.us reader, I want a concise link post about LensVLM, so I can understand the visual-text compression mechanism and its practical tradeoff. Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07019. Use the latest 2026-09-24 Desktop screenshot of Figure 7.

Feature: LensVLM link post
Scenario: Reader opens the short post
Given a published Anth.us post with a 1200x630 preview derived from Figure 7
When the reader opens the post and follows its source link
Then the post explains selective expansion and the source link opens the paper
And the image and social preview render correctly.

comments.text: Drafted short post and 1200×630 Figure 7 cover from Ryan’s newest Desktop screenshot.
